integrity: Exact equations and a complete geometric argument with standalone modular cross-check are supplied. The source date is the first public arXiv submission of the prior source, not the date of this finding.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the literal complete-intersection integral model, not stable/minimal reduction, monodromy, or Picard torsion. Older unindexed treatments could have implicit equivalent coverage. Exact modular checks supplement an algebraic proof; independently audited priority is not claimed.
title: Six concurrent lines in the characteristic-five power-sum model of Bring’s curve
